description: This Java class defines a MessageCommandAdapter, which maps MessageCommand objects to and from an Adaptable representation within a protocol adapter context. It handles how message commands are translated, especially in relation to different message types like claim, feature, or thing messages, and manages associated signal mapping.

classes.name: MessageCommandAdapter
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractAdapter to adapt MessageCommand objects to and from an internal protocol representation, providing specific handling for different message types and mapping signals to adaptables.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method that creates a new instance of MessageCommandAdapter with the specified HeaderTranslator.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a MessageCommand into an Adaptable, defaulting to the LIVE channel.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates whether this adapter is meant for response messages; returns false.

methods.name: requiresSubject
methods.description: Indicates that the adapter requires a subject when mapping; returns true.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the message type based on the subject and payload of the adaptable; returns specific message type strings.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Maps a MessageCommand signal to an Adaptable using a signal mapper.
